name: B10-0538/2026 (PfE) – The illegal Türkiye–Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the illegal Türkiye-Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It states its opinion on a 2019 sea borders deal between Turkey and Libya, which the EU says is invalid. It backs the Great Sea Interconnector, an electricity link between Greece and Cyprus, and says Turkey must not block it. It asks the EU Council and Commission to make Libya's non-implementation of the deal a condition for EU cooperation with Libya.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects Turkey, Libya, Greece and Cyprus, and the planned electricity cable.
- Next, the EU Council and Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
